description: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) end-of-day data for all listed securities, 30 per page in TASE's own order: security ID, ISIN, symbol, name, type (share, bond, warrant, ETF...), last price, % change, base/open/high/low, deals, turnover (ILS thousands), units, market value, monthly and annual yield, bond details (redemption, linkage, coupon) where relevant, trade date and the total count. Use it to scan or page through Israeli listings; type narrows a page to one security type and page walks the list (1 to 100). There is no symbol search: for one company's quote use finance_yahoo_finance, for price history finance_stooq_historical_stocks. Read-only, end-of-day, not real time. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

type.description: Only this type on the page, e.g. Shares, Bonds, Warrant, ETF (contains match)
